verdict.rationale: Airbyte's first-party Terraform provider lets users version-control their Airbyte configuration (connections and syncs) as code, and the Connection Timeline shows historical connection events. Review and rollback of configuration changes are only implied through the IaC workflow, not documented as native features. Missing for 10: native config version history, documented change review/diff for automations, a built-in rollback mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: you can use Airbyte's Terraform provider to automate and version control your Airbyte configuration as code
The Connection Timeline displays historical information about relevant connection events.
